question: Does the fixed BL5 fresh-photo look retain material structure after the strongest per-image EV, white-balance, contrast and saturation diagnostic fit?

evaluation.sampling: deterministic full-raster evenly-spaced aligned pixels including endpoints
evaluation.basic_family: joint EV plus diagonal white balance plus contrast plus saturation
evaluation.fit_role: evaluator-only per-image adversary; never a renderer, candidate fit or product path

branches.pass: retain explicit evidence that BL5 fresh-photo style is not reducible to basic global adjustments
branches.fail: describe BL5 as predominantly basic global adjustment despite any blind preference result; do not retune thresholds or operator

claim_ceiling: fresh-photo evaluator evidence against one strong basic-adjustment adversary; not film truth, stock response, calibration, population preference, universal irreducibility or product promotion
